blind_spots: One fresh trial per hard/version yields observed host-specific improvement only, without a hard-case variance estimate or statistical significance.
Small independent oracle is exhaustive only for its fixed fixtures. Medium/hard saved-set equivalence is regression/cross-version evidence, not an independent exhaustive proof for arbitrary cards.
The heldout suite from algorithm-selection research is not a new secret holdout and is not required for this bounded predecessor speed comparison; no universal algorithm selection claim follows.
GPU/distributed training, arbitrary unsupported effects, opponent/next-turn planning and desktop UI interaction are outside this own-current-turn CLI journey.

Case-level version alternation is executable through the public CLI, but three consecutive medium trials within one invocation cannot remove within-case temporal drift as trial-level alternation could. Report this limitation; it does not change the strict hard compute-sum rule. Exact fixed-slot row equality tests the full saved state representation and pinned record, while small full-state oracle checks provide independent semantic validation; it is not an independent exhaustive oracle for hard fixtures.

Windows background OS activity is not eliminated. Root coordinated absence of competing benchmarks/oracles/compilation; lightweight external observer ran identically across all fresh performance invocations.

External monotonic process duration is quantized by approximately 100ms polling; OS GetProcessTimes supplies exact process timestamps. Worker-reported RSS precedes final report writing; observer peak can be slightly higher.
